name: Conjuring the Mystic Tower
description: A spell which creates a single tower; filling larger underground areas requires a spell of greater complexity.

name: A Network Reminiscent of Rome
description: CrTe 20 ritual that creates a permanent stone road based roughly on Roman road dimensions, up to 3.78 miles long.

name: Bridge of Wood
description: Core spell (ArM5 p.135) cited as an example that creating a bridge needs no extra complexity magnitude.

name: Creation of the Walls of Simple Cottages
description: CrTe 20 ritual creating a series of identical stone cottage enclosures linked by thin stone so they count as an Individual target.

name: Creation of a Legion of Appointed Cottages
description: CrTe 30 ritual creating identical stone houses with roofs, floors, doors, shutters and plumbing, nine per casting.

name: Creation of a Well-Appointed Town
description: CrTe 30 ritual creating well-appointed cottages, the road between them and the water and sewage pipes within the road.

name: A System of Narrow Canals
description: CrTe 20 ritual creating a stone-lined canal network 2 paces deep and 5 wide, up to 1.26 miles long.

name: Canals that Accommodate Seagoing Vessels
description: CrTe 20 ritual creating a stone-lined canal wide and deep enough for seagoing ships, up to 909 paces long.

name: The Creation of a Forest
description: CrHe 40 ritual that creates a thousand mature trees.

name: The Creation of Acorns Aplenty
description: CrHe 20 ritual that creates a vast pile of acorns totaling 1,000 cubic paces.

name: The Creation of Verdant Grassland
description: CrHe 10 ritual covering about 1.25 acres with thick grass a pace high.

name: A Pile of Rotting Beef
description: CrAn 35 spell creating ten cow carcasses of Sun duration, from whose decay natural bees are generated.

name: Growth of Creeping Things
description: Spell mentioned as an alternative way to generate bees, one of the insects created when destroying beef.

name: A Careful Removal of a Perfect Landscape
description: ReTe 35 ritual with Boundary target that slices off a piece of countryside and floats it through the air at a running horse's speed.

name: The Second Remove of the Giant's Dance
description: ReTe 35 ritual that uproots a structure such as Stonehenge and floats it through the air.

name: Weather Made Good
description: MuAq 40 Boundary ritual preventing rain from falling on the island for a month.

name: Aegis of the Hearth
description: Core ward ritual (ArM5 p.161), an obvious choice to cast around the whole island, though it may repel faeries.

name: Circle of Beast Warding
description: Core ward spell (ArM5 p.120) suggested as useful during individual stories on the island.

name: Ward Against Faeries
description: Family of elemental wards against faeries, suggested as useful during island stories.

name: Ward Against the Beasts of Legend
description: Core ward spell (ArM5 p.120) suggested as useful during individual stories.

name: The Shrouded Glen
description: Ward spell that only works if the victim crosses the ward before seeing the island, requiring a marked boundary.

name: The Command of Every Beast
description: ReAn 20 Boundary ritual letting the magus give a one-sentence command to every beast on the island.

name: The Eyes of Every Beast
description: InAn 40 Boundary ritual letting the magus sense what the island's animals are seeing.

name: Fumigant of Minor Demons
description: PeVi General Boundary ritual, a variant of Demon's Eternal Oblivion, destroying minor infernal spirits on the island.

name: Demon's Eternal Oblivion
description: Core spell (ArM5 p.160) of which Fumigant of Minor Demons is a variant.

name: The Lost City
description: PeIm 45 Boundary ritual with Rego requisite that makes the island wall and everything within it invisible to outsiders.

name: Murderous Woodland
description: ReHe 55 Boundary ritual that wakens every tree on the island to walk and fight on command.

name: Remembered Messages
description: MuMe 20 Boundary ritual that replaces a prepared memory in everyone on the island with a single useful piece of information.

name: Speech of the Warding Ring
description: InTe 35 spell allowing characters to speak with far larger stones, such as the island's stone jacket.

name: Stone Tell of the Mind that Sits
description: Most popular Hermetic spell for interrogating rocks (ArM5 p.153), limited to a pace-sized target.

name: Strange Tricks Using Canal Contents
description: MuAq 25 Boundary ritual transforming water in the island's canals into another natural liquid such as oil, wine or honey.

name: A Spell for the Defense of the Realm Against Expected Invasion
description: MuCo 50 Boundary ritual adding +3 Soak to all humans on the island for a day or night.

name: Push of the Gentle Wave
description: Core spell (ArM5 p.124) that several faerie powers resemble, moving boats or swimmers with a current.

name: Voice of the Lake
description: Core spell (ArM5 p.122) that the faerie power Conversing with the Sea resembles.

name: Stygian Waters
description: Telechine power mixing Stygian water (Perdo vis) with sulfur to create a poison fatal to all men, beasts and plants.

name: Toxic Visage
description: Telechine power whereby those who see the creature's true face die.

name: Lord of Imaginem
description: Manannan's Focus Power allowing any non-ritual Imaginem effect of level 40 or below.

name: Distant Eidolon
description: Manannan's power to create an illusory form to converse and deliver messages, giving him Arcane Connections.

name: Extended Glamor
description: Faerie power granting awareness of everything within a chosen domain and producing vis; lets faeries extend auras.

name: Fleet of Woodchips or Rushes
description: Manannan's power creating an illusory fleet of a hundred crewed vessels to scare away invaders.

name: Grant Lost Love Flaw
description: Manannan's ritual power: shaking his cloak between two people ensures they never meet again.

name: Growth and Shrinking
description: Manannan's paired Focus Powers letting him alter his size with spells up to level 25.

name: Manifestation
description: Faerie power manifesting consciousness among animals and plants within its glamour, simulating CrAn, ReAn, CrHe or ReHe effects.

name: Shift Human Shapes
description: Faerie power allowing change of appearance to any human configuration, used by Manannan to roam the countryside.

name: Spirit Away
description: Power allowing Manannan to act as threshold guardian and open gates into Faerie.

name: Stroke of Death
description: The power making Manannan's sword lethally sharp, an immediately fatal effect.

name: Summon the Rider of the Waves
description: Manannan's power, similar to Push of the Gentle Wave, to upturn boats or force ships away from the island.

name: Transform into Impenetrable Fog
description: Manannan's power to become a great cloud hiding the island.

name: Transform into Tide
description: Manannan's power to become the upper layer of the sea, carrying boats as he wishes.

name: Transform into Thunderstorm
description: Manannan's power to become a vast bank of thunderclouds driving winds and hail at foes.

name: Transform into Wheel of Flame
description: Manannan's power to transform into a wheel of flame, his most dangerous physical combat form.

name: Crafter of Water
description: Power duplicating any Creo or Rego Aquam spell of level 35 or below at 1 Might per magnitude; possessed by Phorcys and the Elemental Spirit of the Waves.

name: Master of Water
description: Phorcys' power duplicating any Muto or Perdo Aquam spell of level 35 or below.

name: Enliven the Gross Water
description: Phorcys' ritual power to create and control a water elemental of Might up to 39.

name: Damaging Effect
description: Faerie power increasing the damage of a weapon or bite by +5, possessed by Auvekoejaks, icthyocentaurs and death sharks.

name: Conversing with the Sea
description: Auvekoejak power allowing them to ask questions of their local part of the ocean.

name: Transform into Human
description: Auvekoejak power to take human form, treated as a level 25 effect.

name: Flight
description: Faerie power letting the Inverted fly in their boats and throw nets and javelins over supernatural distances.

name: Hound
description: Death shark power letting it know the distance and direction of a particular dying human.

name: Drown
description: Elemental Spirit of the Waves power to engulf a smaller target after a melee hit, forcing deprivation rolls.

name: Coagulation
description: Demonic power manufacturing a solid body from ambient unformed matter; forced to be abandoned on Holy Saturday.

name: Envisioning
description: Demonic power to appear in and distort mortal dreams.

name: Obsession
description: Demonic power imposing a temporary sinful Personality trait that may become permanent.

name: His Master's Voice
description: Rumael's power to summon lesser demons without controlling them.

name: Master of Storm and Sea
description: Rumael's power to create Creo, Muto or Rego effects affecting storms and water.

name: Shroud the Stench of the Pit
description: Rumael's power making an Infernal power appear magical, faerie or mundane.

name: The Wealth of Nations
description: Rumael's power summoning up to 40 pounds of gold from wherever its absence causes most trouble.

name: Dexithea
description: A telechine, the last surviving of the titan smiths, who dwells deep in the sea and can craft magic items; Magic Might 45.

name: Telechines
description: A small group of titans, wizards and smiths who fought for the Olympians, made Cronus' sickle and Poseidon's trident, then created a deadly poison.

name: Blood of the Telechines
description: Heritage granting +1 Dexterity and an extra Major Virtue (usually Ways of the Waters), with the Supernatural Nuisance Flaw.

name: Phorcys
description: Lord of the Barren Sea before Poseidon, god of death in the sea and father of sea monsters; an Aspect of him is a Magic spirit of Might 40.

name: Poseidon
description: Olympian sea god, ally and possibly foster-son of the telechines, who usurped Phorcys' kingdom.

name: Athena
description: Olympian whose followers invaded Rhodes, home of the telechines.

name: Cronus
description: Titan whose sickle was created by the telechines.

name: Olympians
description: The Olympian gods who destroyed the telechines' fortress; faeries claiming Olympian descent hate telechines.

name: Titanomachy
description: The war of titans and Olympians in which the telechines fought on the Olympian side.

name: Manannan Mac Lir
description: Irish faerie sovereign and wizard-king, once god of Irish sailors and the Isle of Man; a shapeshifter with Faerie Might 55.

name: Tursus
description: Almost a faerie god of northern merfolk, lord of seal beaches, likely to accompany invading Norse; Faerie Might 40.

name: Auvekoejaks
description: Vicious tribe of northern merfolk, minions of Tursus, seal or walrus from the waist down, who never run out of javelins.

name: Frangarach
description: Manannan's sword, the Answerer, which always kills his opponent.

name: Wave Sweeper
description: Manannan's ship, which travels as swiftly as he wishes regardless of the wind.

name: Enbarr
description: Manannan's horse, Splendid Mane, which runs faster than the wind and trots across water.

name: Breastplate of Manannan
description: Manannan's breastplate that no weapon can pierce, Protection +20, resizing to his forms.

name: Cloak of Manannan
description: Manannan's cloak that can be any color, make him invisible, shelter a place in fog and prevent two people meeting again.

name: Crane Skin Bag
description: Manannan's bag of crane skin containing the External Vis Sources of dozens of dead Irish gods.

name: Cup of Truth
description: Manannan's cup which breaks if a lie is told by one who drinks from it.

name: Helmet of Invisibility
description: Helmet which, according to some, grants Manannan perfect invisibility (PeIm 40 effect).

name: Treasures of Manannan
description: Manannan's four or five magic items, which he may lend and which return to him if lost.

name: Tir Tairngire
description: Manannan's realm, the Land of Promise, also called Emain Ablach, the Isle of Apples or Avalon.

name: Isle of Arran
description: Island where a faerie once held Manannan's court; now claimed by a covenant of Criamon magi studying regiones.

name: Covenant on the Isle of Arran
description: Covenant of Criamon magi studying regiones who can show the path to Manannan's realm.

name: Isle of Man
description: Island of which Manannan was god until cast out by Saint Patrick; subject of a Grand Tribunal ruling on Tribunal membership.

name: Icthyocentaurs
description: Faerie tribe of amphibious, armored centaurs mimicking chivalric knights; can serve as companions.

name: The Inverted
description: Merfolk-derived faeries placed on land who sail sky-boats and net birds as fishers do fish.

name: Death Shark
description: Psychopompic faerie shark, white with red eyes, that waits in the shallows until a sea-connected person dies.

name: Elemental Spirit of the Waves
description: Potent water elemental possibly penned inside the island's wall, dying and furious; Magic Might 35.

name: Merfolk
description: Aquatic faeries found in the North Sea, described in Realms of Power: Faerie.

name: Selkies
description: Seal faeries of the North Sea able to come onto land.

name: Rumael
description: Demon posing as Neptune, creator and destroyer of Atlantis; Lord of the False Gods, patron of a kingdom that no longer exists; Infernal Might 40.

name: Neptune
description: Sea god whom Rumael falsely claims to be.

name: The Wicked Boys of the Third Square
description: Race of tiny demons with horse heads serving Rumael, who wreck things and steal beer and hats.

name: False Gods
description: Demonic order to which Rumael belongs, accompanied by animals that extend their bodies.

name: Watchers
description: Demons said to have fallen when they married into the Race of Men; possibly appointed to subvert kingdoms.

name: Atlantis
description: Legendary realm reported by the Greeks and ruled by Poseidon, which Rumael claims to have created and destroyed.

name: Merlin
description: Sorcerer who moved Stonehenge from Ireland as the grave marker of Uther Pendragon.

name: Uther Pendragon
description: King whose grave marker Stonehenge was, moved by Merlin.

name: Brutus
description: Prince of the Trojans who used the Stone of London as an altar to Diana on landing in Britain.

name: Diana
description: Goddess to whom the Stone of London was an altar.

name: Stone of London
description: Ancient stone in London said to be linked to the city's prosperity, a powerful tether for sovereignty magic.

name: Stonehenge
description: Monument of petrified giants moved from Ireland by Merlin, called the Giants' Dance.

name: Stonehenge Tribunal
description: Tribunal bordering the North Sea, not yet defined in this edition, leaving room for troupe factions.

name: Normandy Tribunal
description: Turbulent Tribunal full of Tytalus magi, with feudal covenant relations and contests over a common prize pool.

name: Rhine Tribunal
description: Factional Tribunal split between conservative covenants and the Lotharingian group seeking secession.

name: Loch Leglean Tribunal
description: Tribunal whose insular magi a North Sea covenant might choose to join.

name: Lotharingians
description: Group of northern Rhineland covenants wishing to break away and form a new Tribunal.

name: House Tytalus
description: Hermetic House with many magi in Normandy, currently divided between two claimants for leadership.

name: House Jerbiton
description: Hermetic House whose magi spread stories of wizards and awaits Blessed Cyprian's miracle.

name: House Criamon
description: Hermetic House; Criamon magi claim the Isle of Arran and Saint Nerius was a Criamon.

name: Redcaps
description: Hermetic messengers; the Redcaps of London would resist removal of the Stone of London.

name: Quaesitores
description: Hermetic investigators whose concerns must be settled when founding the new realm.

name: Grand Tribunal
description: Order-wide Tribunal whose rulings (e.g. on the Isle of Man) set precedent for Tribunal membership and creation.

name: Tribunal
description: Regional Hermetic governing bodies; the North Sea is treated as a natural border between them.

name: Dedication
description: Legal recognition of a covenant as a place given a particular task, drawing specialists from across the Order.

name: Certamen
description: Hermetic magical duel that may be used to force Tytalus settlers off the island.

name: Order of Hermes
description: The Order of Hermetic magi, drawn upon for specialists and governed by Tribunals.

name: Saint Brendan
description: Patron of Irish sailors and arguably intercessor for islands in the Ocean.

name: Blessed Cyprian
description: Penitent magician who may perform a miracle to be recognized as a saint, long awaited by House Jerbiton.

name: Saint Nerius
description: Criamon magus, saint of pious magi, not recognized by the Church.

name: Saint Nicholas
description: Patron of sailors, followed in some traditions by a little demon that torments naughty children.

name: Saint Patrick
description: Saint who cast Manannan out of the Isle of Man and overcame the druids.

name: King John
description: English king whose treasure was lost in a tidal surge crossing the Wash.

name: Treasure of King John
description: King John's baggage train lost in the Wash; a small gold crown fragment may serve as an Arcane Connection to the rest.

name: Frederick II
description: Holy Roman Emperor based in Sicily, patron of arts, nearly atheist, a possible overlord for the island's king.

name: Isabella II
description: Seven-year-old Queen of Jerusalem in Outremer, a possible sovereign for the island.

name: Philip Augustus
description: King of France and great master of politics in Western Europe, perpetually seeking land for his sons.

name: Philip Hurepel
description: Nineteen-year-old landless son of Philip Augustus who might be appointed ruler.

name: Richard, Duke of Cornwall
description: Teenage brother of Henry III, a gifted administrator who in real history buys the title of Holy Roman Emperor.

name: Henry III
description: Young King of England whose realm is run by a Council of Regency; had to repeat his coronation.

name: Valdemar II
description: Expansionist crusader King of Denmark with Baltic territories.

name: William Longespee
description: Earl of Salisbury, bastard son of Henry II, a loyal general and naval raider, enemy of Peter de Roches.

name: Henry II
description: King who praised his bastard son William Longespee.

name: Richard the Lionheart
description: Legitimate son of Henry II.

name: Earl of Norfolk
description: Powerful English noble facing the North Sea, husband of William Longespee's mother.

name: Peter de Roches
description: Churchman who has care of the young king and all but rules England; hates William Longespee.

name: Normans
description: English families who came over with the Conqueror, in fragile peace with the Poitevins.

name: Poitevins
description: Faction who came to England with King John's wife and are currently ascendant.

name: Plantagenet
description: Royal family of England, not known for patience.

name: Patrick, Count of Dunbar
description: Powerful noble with lands on both sides of the Anglo-Scottish border, claiming descent from Duncan.

name: Malcolm Big-Head
description: Ancestor of the current Scottish royal line, who defeated MacBeth.

name: MacBeth the Good
description: Scottish king defeated by Malcolm Big-Head.

name: Lulach the Unready
description: Adopted son of MacBeth.

name: Duncan Bad Blooded
description: MacBeth's predecessor, claimed ancestor of the Earls of Dunbar.

name: Jon Haraldsson
description: Mormaer of Caithness and Earl of Orkney, holding land from Scotland and Norway; implicated in burning a bishop.

name: Bishop Adam
description: Bishop of Caithness, possibly a faerie, found as a baby in a basket and killed over a butter tax.

name: Pandulf Marca
description: Italian-born bishop of Norwich, papal legate and chairman of England's Council of Regency, known for nepotism.

name: James the Legate
description: Papal chaplain linked to Saint Victor in Paris, appointed legate to Scotland and the Isles in 1220; an Augustinian.

name: Council of Regency
description: Council which runs England on behalf of Henry III, chaired by Pandulf.

name: Augustinian Order
description: Religious order of which the legate James is a member.

name: Church
description: The Roman Church, claiming universal power in Mythic Europe, with which the new kingdom must come to terms.

name: Jews
description: Western Jewish communities who might flee persecution to the magical country.

name: North Sea
description: Shallow sea chosen as the site for the magical island, a natural border between Hermetic Tribunals.

name: Dogger Bank
description: Shallowest part of the North Sea and a rich fishing ground whose destruction would cause famine and war.

name: Dover Strait
description: Strait averaging 33 paces deep.

name: Shetland Islands
description: Islands marking the northern limit of the shallower North Sea.

name: London
description: City containing the Stone of London, with its Redcaps and faerie courts.

name: Rhodes
description: Home of the telechines, invaded by followers of Athena.

name: The Wash
description: Estuary where King John's baggage train was lost in a tidal surge.

name: Alexandria
description: Canal city praised for the purity of its air.

name: Ravenna
description: Canal city praised for the purity of its air.

name: Atlantic Ocean
description: The epitomic Ocean, with majestic waves that may provide a weak aura tether.

name: Irish Sea
description: Sea around which faeries claiming Manannan's role are found.

name: Outremer
description: The crusader east where Isabella II resides.

name: Sicily
description: Center of Frederick II's power.

name: Debatable Land
description: Borderland between England and Scotland where Patrick of Dunbar acts as judge.

name: Nidaros
description: Norwegian archiepiscopal see, now Trondheim, claiming authority over Scottish bishops.

name: Saint Victor
description: Church in Paris to which the legate James is linked.

name: Magic Aura
description: Aura connected to the Magic Realm, developing via natural beauty, ancient structures, great rituals or magical creatures.

name: Faerie Aura
description: Aura created by powerful faeries, aiding spellcasting and lab work.

name: Magical Tether
description: Mystical link that anchors an aura; created by rituals of level 45+, age of structures, or natural beauty.

name: Vis
description: Raw magical power which forms in Magic auras and is scarce on a newly created island.

name: Tainted Vis
description: Vis sordida of Infernal origin that adds to casting totals but adds botch dice and sinful traits.

name: Ritual
description: Hermetic spells required for permanent creations and Boundary targets, minimum level 20, needing vis.

name: Boundary
description: Spell target covering an area within a marked boundary; the island's wall serves as one.

name: Ring and Circle Wards
description: Wards traced as a ring, difficult to cast around an island.

name: Arcane Connection
description: Link to a target used in magic; a fragment of King John's treasure might be one.

name: Parma Magica
description: Hermetic magic resistance, which does not resist Manannan's flaming form damage.

name: Spirit of Place
description: Spirit tied to a location's aura, resisting its theft; Genius Loci in Realms of Power: Magic.

name: External Vis Source
description: Virtue holding a faerie's vis in external treasures; Manannan's bag holds those of dead Irish gods.

name: Magic Resistance
description: Resistance to supernatural effects; kings gain some from coronation.

name: Faerie
description: The Faerie realm and faerie beings, which follow settlers and bring vis and auras.

name: Magic Realm
description: Realm of Power to which areas of great natural beauty are innately connected.

name: Infernal
description: The Infernal realm of demons, whose hierarchy vies over the new kingdom.

name: Dominion
description: The Divine realm's influence, which Manannan cannot face down.

name: Coronation
description: Elaborate ceremony, involving bishops, a great church and anointing, required to establish a new king.

name: Papal Legate
description: Envoy with most of the powers of the Pope, sent to distant realms.

name: Demon Weakness
description: Each demon's vulnerability, knowable with Infernal Lore, which forces flight or prevents harm to a protected group.

name: Ways of the Waters
description: Virtue granting bonuses in water, usual extra Major Virtue for telechine blood.

name: Supernatural Nuisance
description: Flaw held by telechine descendants and Phorcys.

name: Magic Human
description: Virtue of Dexithea marking her as a Magic being in human form.

name: Death Prophecy
description: Flaw of Dexithea.

name: Strong Willed
description: Virtue of Dexithea.

name: Magical Monster
description: Flaw of Dexithea and Phorcys.

name: Plagued by Olympian Faeries
description: Dexithea's flaw reflecting enmity of Olympian faeries.

name: Proud
description: Personality Flaw held by Dexithea and Phorcys.

name: Good Teacher
description: Minor Virtue of Dexithea.

name: Great Characteristic
description: Virtue raising characteristics, held by Dexithea and Phorcys.

name: Improved Characteristics
description: Virtue raising characteristics.

name: Keen Vision
description: Minor Virtue of Dexithea.

name: Puissant Smith
description: Dexithea's minor Virtue boosting Craft: Smith.

name: Tough
description: Minor Virtue of Dexithea.

name: Ways of the Deep Earth
description: Minor Virtue of Dexithea.

name: Magic Spirit
description: Phorcys' essential nature as a spirit of Magic.

name: Daimon
description: Phorcys' Virtue marking him as an aspect of a greater being.

name: No Fatigue
description: Quality freeing a creature from fatigue.

name: Huge
description: Virtue increasing Size, held by Manannan, Tursus and icthyocentaurs.

name: Highly Cognizant
description: Faerie Virtue of Manannan.

name: Faerie Sight
description: Faerie Virtue held by Manannan, Tursus and other faeries.

name: Faerie Speech
description: Faerie Virtue and Pretense for speaking.

name: Increased Might
description: Faerie Virtue raising Might.

name: Sight Beyond Sight
description: Faerie Virtue of Manannan.

name: Traditional Ward
description: Faerie Flaw; Manannan's against the Dominion, Tursus' against Norse sea chants.

name: Grant Major Virtue
description: Faerie Virtue letting the creature grant Virtues or items to mortals.

name: Greater Faerie Power
description: Faerie Virtue granting a greater power.

name: Focus Power
description: Quality allowing spell-like use of a whole category of effects.

name: Monstrous Appearance
description: Flaw of Tursus and needed by icthyocentaurs.

name: Incognizant
description: Faerie Flaw of lacking full awareness, common among the faeries here.

name: Hybrid Form
description: Faerie Virtue of half-human forms.

name: Personal Faerie Power
description: Faerie Virtue held by Auvekoejaks.

name: Restricted Might
description: Auvekoejak flaw restricting Might on land.

name: Sovereign Ward
description: Faerie Flaw; broken codes can destroy the faerie.

name: Aloof
description: Faerie Flaw of Auvekoejaks.

name: Feast of the Dead
description: Faerie Virtue suitable for Auvekoejak companions.

name: Lesser Power
description: Faerie Virtue granting a lesser power.

name: Humanoid Form
description: Faerie Virtue of the Inverted.

name: Monstrous Form
description: Death shark flaw.

name: Magic Thing
description: Nature of the Elemental Spirit of the Waves.

name: Poor Memory
description: Flaw of the Elemental Spirit of the Waves.

name: Short Attention Span
description: Flaw of the Elemental Spirit of the Waves.

name: Simple Minded
description: Flaw of the Elemental Spirit of the Waves.

name: Temporary Magical Might
description: Quality whereby wounds reduce the elemental's Might pool.

name: True Love
description: Flaw cited as causing predictable breaches of secrecy.

name: Gently Gifted
description: Virtue letting magi rule directly without the Gift's social penalty.

name: Magic Lore
description: Ability referenced in creature statistics or rolls in this text.

name: Area Lore
description: Ability referenced in creature statistics or rolls in this text.

name: Faerie Lore
description: Ability referenced in creature statistics or rolls in this text.

name: Infernal Lore
description: Ability referenced in creature statistics or rolls in this text.

name: Dominion Lore
description: Ability referenced in creature statistics or rolls in this text.

name: Church Lore
description: Ability referenced in creature statistics or rolls in this text.

name: Concentration
description: Ability referenced in creature statistics or rolls in this text.

name: Awareness
description: Ability referenced in creature statistics or rolls in this text.

name: Craft: Smith
description: Ability referenced in creature statistics or rolls in this text.

name: Single Weapon
description: Ability referenced in creature statistics or rolls in this text.

name: Brawl
description: Ability referenced in creature statistics or rolls in this text.

name: Thrown Weapon
description: Ability referenced in creature statistics or rolls in this text.

name: Swim
description: Ability referenced in creature statistics or rolls in this text.

name: Athletics
description: Ability referenced in creature statistics or rolls in this text.

name: Penetration
description: Ability referenced in creature statistics or rolls in this text.

name: Chirurgy
description: Ability referenced in creature statistics or rolls in this text.

name: Survival
description: Ability referenced in creature statistics or rolls in this text.

name: Hunt
description: Ability referenced in creature statistics or rolls in this text.

name: Leadership
description: Ability referenced in creature statistics or rolls in this text.

name: Carouse
description: Ability referenced in creature statistics or rolls in this text.

name: Charm
description: Ability referenced in creature statistics or rolls in this text.

name: Folk Ken
description: Ability referenced in creature statistics or rolls in this text.

name: Teaching
description: Ability referenced in creature statistics or rolls in this text.

name: Intrigue
description: Ability referenced in creature statistics or rolls in this text.

name: Bargain
description: Ability referenced in creature statistics or rolls in this text.

name: Artes Liberales
description: Ability referenced in creature statistics or rolls in this text.

name: Creo
description: Hermetic Technique used in this text's spells and powers.

name: Rego
description: Hermetic Technique used in this text's spells and powers.

name: Muto
description: Hermetic Technique used in this text's spells and powers.

name: Perdo
description: Hermetic Technique used in this text's spells and powers.

name: Intellego
